annotations.description: With all opponent lands tapped (no combat trick risk), GPT54 declined to block Lightning-Core Excavator (0/3) with Emancipation Angel (3/3). This was a free kill on a creature that threatens 3 damage via its activated ability later, with zero risk to the Angel.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 1 damage from Disciple of Perdition.
annotations.betterLine: Block Lightning-Core Excavator with Emancipation Angel to destroy it for free, removing the future threat of its 3-damage sacrifice ability.

annotations.description: Cast Angelic Ascension on Sling-Gang Lieutenant, exiling a 1/1 but giving the opponent a 4/4 flying Angel token. The Sling-Gang could drain at most 2 more life (sacrificing the goblin token and itself), but a 4/4 flyer is a much bigger threat. GPT54 is at 14 life vs opponent at 7 - the game is favorable and there's no urgency to remove Sling-Gang at this cost.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Angelic Ascension targeting Sling-Gang Lieutenant, giving opponent a 4/4 flying Angel token
annotations.betterLine: Pass without casting anything, take the 3 damage (go to 11 life), then next turn play a 5th land and deploy Baneslayer Angel or Serra Angel. The Sling-Gang's remaining drain potential (~2 life) is far less threatening than a 4/4 flyer. If wanting to use Angelic Ascension at all during combat, targeting Disciple of Perdition would be better to prevent its death trigger.
